mod57_p4a_alternative_weeks_1_6_picks_cl.classification_evidence: Season-block bootstrap, probability_positive reported; no refuted mechanism and no closing ground.
mod57_p4a_alternative_weeks_1_6_picks_cl.description: Pick accuracy minus 50 against the close, weeks 1-6, side of the later-market label (weeks 1 to 4 ahead); future-information label, not servable; decisive games; season-block bootstrap
mod57_p4a_alternative_weeks_1_6_picks_cl.notes: Later-market rating label (closing lines of later weeks of the same season) versus the hindsight label, weeks 1-6; uses future lines, training label only. Later lines re-rate each team for its own game, so the label carries the game's own result (calibration slope above 1); a higher slope here is contamination, not quality.
mod57_p4a_alternative_weeks_1_6_picks_cl.plain_summary: Whether what the market thinks of two teams a few weeks later is a cleaner target for how wrong the early line is than game results are.
